sentences.text: In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
Each experiment was repeated 5 times with different random seeds.
We trained each model for 100 epochs with a batch size of 64.
Figure 1 shows the validation accuracy of LSTM by dataset.
On MNIST, LSTM obtains a validation accuracy of 97.2%.
LSTM achieves 77.8% validation accuracy on SVHN (Figure 1).
As shown in Figure 1, LSTM scores 7.1 points higher on CIFAR-10 than on IMDB.
As shown in Figure 1, LSTM achieves 27.8% validation accuracy on SVHN.
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy by dataset.
As shown in Figure 2, VGG-16 outperforms MLP by about 18 percentage points on CIFAR-10.
On SVHN, Ours is 2.6 points better than MLP (Figure 2).
On CIFAR-10, DistilBERT is about 5 points better than Ours (Figure 2).
MLP achieves 65.2% validation accuracy on CIFAR-10 (Figure 2).
Random Forest reaches 81.1% accuracy on MNIST.
Overall, the results are in line with what we expected from the literature.
